body:
Required native role launches failed in the managed cloud environment even though the CLI reported a stored login. This change documents the separate initialization, authentication and MCP failures and permits supported fresh host tool sessions for future eligible roles after independent policy acceptance.

The demonstrated route completed a small documentation author task and a separate independent review. Scientific roles keep their blind packets, separate ownership, frozen test checkpoints and verification gates. Shared filesystem access is disclosed as a prompt boundary, not engineered isolation. Native authentication remains unresolved; no credentials, executable launcher, permission grants or product behavior changed.

Closes #107. Related setup/recovery work in #105/#106 remains separate.

<details>
<summary>Technical appendix: evidence and validation</summary>

### Scope and independent review

- The role-launch procedure now distinguishes executor availability, CLI/parser installation, stored login, actual launch, completed exact artifact and substantive independent review. It documents expiry/resume/missing-tool handling and explicitly labels unexercised failure cases.
- New managed-cloud sessions use supported no-history controls (`fork_turns="none"`), explicit packet/model settings and session/artifact identities. Missing required capabilities block the route. No retroactive verdict qualification or silent migration of active tasks.
- Fresh policy/investigation review accepted original candidate `b84b178` with no findings. Fresh integration/disposition review then accepted `be8e447` with no findings: current main's math documents are preserved exactly, all nine accepted policy surfaces are unchanged, and original observations/dispositions remain immutable. The final PR changes nine policy files and nine task/evidence files; no executable, workflow, dependency or product changes.
- Native probes: outer initialization failure exit 1, then approved outer retry with inner read-only sandbox reproduced HTTP 401/token-refresh and separate MCP HTTP 451; no model response. No causal relationship or owner logout was inferred.
- Fresh tool author/reviewer pilot: one author, one independent ACCEPT, zero corrections. Exact artifact SHA-256 `d2b544d18247fa45fcb21074a4fb9ecdaf6f594b1037caafc09893c68c6cdbd3`. This proves the observed documentation transport only, not scientific quality or native repair.

### Lessons-doctor recurrence

The [November 14 lessons-doctor update to #107](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/issues/107#lessons-doctor-recurrence--2026-11-14) reports the same failure layers at baseline `4dcc50dd70da2f93b4a3360e0a4160144656b35a`. After bypassing a stale installed entry point by invoking the current `simrecon_devtools.delivery.main` with the existing interpreter, native initialization failed on the read-only filesystem. An approved outer retry preserved the doctor's read-only sandbox, then exited 1 with HTTP 401/token-refresh failure; MCP also reported HTTP 451. **No doctor analysis completed.** These are reported recurrence evidence, not additional probes performed by CLOUD107, and no common root cause or human sign-out is inferred.

The stale entry point and dependency-fetch restrictions remain setup observations associated with #105/#106, not newly established runtime defects. The update expressly preserves #107's completion criteria and role/verification boundaries. It does not extend #84's task-specific exception.

The [existing doctor launcher](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/blob/b84b178f7f4b8b49ae815296677f028878524a6e/devtools/src/simrecon_devtools/delivery.py#L23) still invokes `codex exec`. This PR's fresh tool-session policy does not automatically reroute that CLI, repair native authentication, fix a stale installation, or certify a completed doctor run. The demonstrated alternative and scoped policy acceptance above remain the basis for this issue's supported-route outcome.

### Candidate and verification

- Candidate: `be8e447aa45d75b1ec1d53f52ce9452910575163`; tree `e6f529cac9861287faa69f155021f3a5ec2e68a9`.
- Current integrated base: `87163657dd4e43e98adbc64ef8eca268c033084c`. Fresh fetch and the three-way merge completed cleanly, preserving PR #110's math-documentation correction. No textual conflict remained.
- Full local `make verify` passed all 13 phases on this clean unchanged candidate: **3,369 tests passed**, 47 warnings. Required Ubuntu CI also passed on the new PR test-merge; earlier CI remains historical evidence only.
- The [new append-only disposition](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/blob/be8e447aa45d75b1ec1d53f52ce9452910575163/docs/lessons/dispositions/20261114T191207Z-cloud107-coordinator-reconcile-launch-investigation.md) resolves RM84-F001's original investigation completion conditions, includes the doctor's corroborating recurrence, preserves unresolved native authentication/doctor execution, and leaves CLOUD107-F001's `no-action` scope intact. It does not infer repair from issue closure or certify doctor analysis.
- The owner explicitly authorized auto-merge after reconciliation and checks. No test checkpoint is invented; no protection bypass or release is authorized.

### Local check provenance and measurements

Run 2026-11-14T19:12:57.457073+00:00–2026-11-14T19:29:36.537598+00:00, Debian 13.6 x86_64, Python 3.13.12, uv 0.12.19, Temurin 21.0.7+6. Actual invocation used the existing pinned activation and:

```sh
make verify UV=/workspace/.simrecon-tools/uv-env/bin/uv \
  PYTHON=/workspace/simrecon/.venv/bin/python \
  VERIFY_ARGS='--contract CLOUD107 --base 87163657dd4e43e98adbc64ef8eca268c033084c'
```

Receipt SHA-256 `8816edd7b8546df1ba1ba998aadb361b01d47391dc23e5101c26de36a1c4e98d`. The local host is not Ubuntu platform proof; required CI is reported separately. No required report or phase was omitted. Coverage percentages remain advisory. Current JSON/HTML integrity includes all owned files, never-imported code and relevant subprocesses, with no new exclusions:

| Scope | Native statements covered/total | Branch destinations covered/total |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Global | 5054/5215 | 1916/2042 |
| simrecon | 4206/4364 | 1593/1714 |
| simrecon_devtools | 39/39 | 8/8 |
| scripts | 809/812 | 315/320 |

Native statements mean executable source lines, not a separate language-level statement metric. Counts are local-only and not a platform union or complete-behavior guarantee.

Product wheel 0.1.0 SHA-256 `d808751c5f11b04d1d13badc082d1c4c578afe7e26dc1fb4520e077a60c888ca`. Development wheel 0.1.0 SHA-256 `177054cef0020008805abe3de9d8bbcd97b78eb26a449ca66a04b2aa4c3c21bd`. Both installed-wheel checks passed.

Same-run M25: baseline/peak 102208 KiB, observed high-water increment 0 bytes, unchanged limit 33,554,432 bytes; run ID `2f62b42b-b3f9-4172-93c6-5f3f074037da`, report SHA-256 `e6f5e6badb861541353af432f9b9c4b960cfe2ecb70579d43a901460cfede718`. Zero high-water increment is not a zero-allocation claim.

Original policy/investigation review accepted candidate `b84b178` with zero corrections. Exact manifest SHA-256: policy `3c53e47b59db06e3a38cde0713a5269f00ac52e8832802c361d7ac6d0f253c92`, investigation `a10f6467f3bf03ea6865dc0a26aa73774b373743035cd2a51735e4018fd3825d` (sorted SHA-256 plus relative-path records). All 17 original candidate digests, 135 local link destinations and whitespace passed that review. The new integration/disposition review independently accepted `be8e447` and checked main-content preservation, unchanged policy/source/test/workflow scope, immutable lesson records, pilot identity, 15 relative-link destinations, whitespace and absent conflict markers. Both review rounds had zero corrections.

### Required Ubuntu CI

[Current run 43632410357](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/actions/runs/43632410357) passed on Ubuntu 24.04.5: **3,369 tests passed**, 47 warnings, with every configured step successful. Logs confirm PR test-merge `36d5ad3fcb0ed96219eb75b36fdbbd3551d95a00`, combining head `be8e447aa45d75b1ec1d53f52ce9452910575163` with base `87163657dd4e43e98adbc64ef8eca268c033084c`, and matching installed-wheel hashes. JSON/HTML coverage reports were generated and retained in [artifact 14129077687](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/actions/runs/43632410357/artifacts/14129077687), 1,189,357 bytes, SHA-256 `e01559aab50d711d65f6c28f61ac08f4646d64ee4d85bb361a3fbb0da36cfea3`. Job logs and artifact metadata were inspected; the CI receipt was not imported locally. Detailed CI package/branch and resource measurements remain in that artifact; local numbers above are not substituted for them.

Historical [run 43627434696](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/actions/runs/43627434696) passed 3,369 tests on original merge `defba037a56d0ed1cfedf79620b300cf8643d4de`. Its [artifact 14127217964](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/actions/runs/43627434696/artifacts/14127217964), 1,189,199 bytes, SHA-256 `b63ecc4fd4b4a6f716f45595f171b84ecce981348e6814c609681fb87dd0990c`, remains evidence for that earlier candidate only. It does not verify this integration. Local artifact-import limitations and every earlier attempt remain in the cumulative execution record.

### Evidence and limits

Tracked sanitized report: [investigation report](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/blob/b84b178f7f4b8b49ae815296677f028878524a6e/docs/reports/cloud-role-launches.md), with both probe receipts and the exact pilot artifact. Scope and execution packets are linked from `docs/tasks/cloud-role-launches.md`. Full local receipts/logs are retained locally under ignored verification/task evidence; they are not represented as durable uploaded artifacts. CI retains its configured artifacts.

Human numeric limits were not set. Requested policy/pilot model was Sol/high; actual serving attribution and complete tokens/cost/elapsed totals remain unknown. Intake adviser/review, environment adviser, failed native probes, failed sandbox preflight/Git access, policy author/review, and integration retry remain charged. The owner subsequently authorized auto-merge for this reconciled PR after checks; release remains outside scope.

</details>
